steps: Group Metro exit taps into pulses (train arrivals) per station; tune the gap so pulses are 3-5 min apart at peak.
For each bus arrival near a station, echo = boardings minus the local baseline over the gap, counted only if a pulse could have walked there in time.
Placebo: run the same method on stops 600-1500 m away and subtract that false-echo rate from nearby stops; cap a stop at 35% and a station at 50% of exits.
Estimate wait from pulse arrival to the next bus, rank fixes by passenger-minutes saved, and find regulars from cards exiting within +-20 min of their own median on 3+ of 4 days.
limits: Transfers are a quick estimate; the placebo and caps are blunt and should be read as indicative.
Stops are matched by name; terminals and large stops merge several physical stops.
Stations with limited bus-stop data (data_quality = limited) have weak estimates.
Only Metro-to-bus flows are estimated; trip-level boardings count total boardings, not load.
Bus data covers 1-7 March; Metro window is 3-6 March.
